outcome: prevalence of pre-existing anti adeno-associated virus serotype 9 antibody (AAV9-Ab) titers
cohort: Participants were 34 children, diagnosed with 5q spinal muscular atrophy (SMA) and younger than two years of age, who were pre-screened for treatment with AAV9-based onasemnogene abeparvovec.
finding: Six of 34 patients had positive AAV9-Ab titers, and no demographic or clinical factors were found to correlate with high AAV9-Ab titers.
